title: Tennis, Pickleball & Racket Sports Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=swingvision:session) OR (index=personal sourcetype=utr:rating)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="swingvision:session","primary",sourcetype="utr:rating","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from swingvision:session and utr:rating to see whether two tennis, pickleball feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `swingvision:session` and `utr:rating` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main tennis, pickleball data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
